name: smwmusic-saga-3-jik-no-hasha-shadow-or-light-hold-out-romancing-saga
title: SaGa 3: Jikū no Hasha: Shadow or Light - Hold Out (Romancing SaGa 2 Mix)
description:
A battle theme from SaGa 3: Jikū no Hasha: Shadow or Light, a DS remake of Final Fantasy Legend III for Game Boy. This track is an original music added in the remake, composed by SaGa series regular Kenji Ito. This port was done with the instruments of Romancing SaGa 2 for SNES. Could fit boss battles or intense level themes.

Thunder sound effect will not work due to omited SMW samples in this port.
